primary_recipe: Use the target session 10:00 America/New_York snapshot of SPXW options expiring that session.
Require positive bid, ask >= bid, bid/ask sizes >= 1 and each leg spread <= 1 index point.
Select up to 7 call/put pairs with smallest absolute midpoint premium difference; require at least 3.
With discount factor approximated as 1, estimate F = median(K + call_mid - put_mid). Require forward dispersion <= 2 points.
Invert each selected call-plus-put premium with the Black straddle formula for total log volatility w; require at least 3 valid inversions and use their median.
For nominal central coverage c, z = NormalInverseCDF((1+c)/2); lower/upper = F * exp(-w^2/2 +/- z*w).
extension_policy: Earlier or previous-session forecasts require a separately registered input profile and chronological evaluation; do not reuse the 10:00 hit rate or its calibration residuals.
failure_policy: Report no forecast with the failed quality check; never silently widen, replace with another model, or count missing as a hit.

existing_mapping.source_timestamp: predictions[].quote_time_et + target_date for the primary profile
existing_mapping.nominal_coverage: band labels 68/95; model levels, not empirical probabilities

output_contract.meaning: Central closing-price research intervals; not intraday high/low bounds and not trade win probabilities.

validation_rules: Use only inputs available at the prediction cutoff; append realized calibration error after all same-day predictions are fixed.
Report coverage together with width, overshoot distance, interval score and skipped dates.
Compare models on identical dates and, where independently verifiable, identical publication cutoffs.
Historical reconstructions and predictions recorded before outcomes must be labeled separately.
Keep each profile/version scorecard separate. Trade selection and P&L optimization do not tune forecast bands.

evidence_at_adoption.interpretation: Previously inspected retrospective sample; not an untouched holdout or guarantee.
